Operators get slog JSON logs with LOG_LEVEL (boot, consumer, relay, DLQ and readiness lines), /healthz liveness and /readyz naming the failing dependency, and data-level signals: outbox SQL (count/min created_at), /reports/freshness, DLQ topics with headers, CronJob state for the sweeps; Kong plugins (prometheus/otel/cors, off by default in the chart, switched on by warehouse-infra values) emit edge telemetry; the context dashboard and Kong/SLO alert rules live in warehouse-infra
practices: A 5xx never leaks its cause: the problem detail is generic, the real error only in logs; method/path are sanitised against log injection (logsafe.go)
Readiness is the single best health signal: a 503 dependency-unavailable problem names the failing dependency (postgres, kafka, analytics)
Transactional outbox relay deletes a sent row; a stuck row shows as outbox.attempts >= OUTBOX_MAX_ATTEMPTS (default 20) with last_error; deterministic poison dead-letters with x-dlq-* headers
Consumer health is log-driven: repeated 'handling failed; retrying the same message' with a growing attempt means a wedged consumer — check broker group lag
